name: Kwame Mensah
intro: I am a 21-year-old undergraduate student in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Rwanda in Kigali (2022–2026). My research interests are in machine learning theory and information extraction, particularly generalization, convex optimization, named entity recognition, and relation extraction.
intro_second: I enjoy connecting mathematical ideas with small, reproducible experiments and studying how to extract reliable structured information from text.
